items.summary: Rail has been such a tough sell for Americans traveling to Europe. Perhaps high-speed rail, climate sensibilities, marketing and competition can change that.

items.summary: American has largely focused on a domestic network strategy. But the money has been in international.

items.title: Southwest Airlines Overhauls Loyalty Program, Gives First Look of New Lounges
items.summary: Southwest’s loyalty changes and new lounges make it even more like the rivals it spent decades trying to set itself apart from.

items.title: Tourism Ireland’s Advice for AI Search: Choose What You Want to Be Famous For
items.summary: With AI changing the face of online discovery, many tourist boards and destinations are grappling with how to finesse the message. For Tourism Ireland, this has prompted it to measure how often it is shaping the answers that AI provides.

items.title: Easing EU Border Friction: There Will Be ‘Flexibility,’ Official Says
items.summary: No-one wants long processing delays at the EU border, and there are signs that a further easing of the EU's biometric Entry/Exit System could be applied as needed. It seems a pragmatic move given that long airport queues are still happening.

items.title: Airlines Can Handle a Crisis – But What About Several at Once?
items.summary: Black swans are starting to look like pigeons in the park. For airlines, the exceptional is becoming routine – and increasingly expensive.

items.title: Is Airbnb’s Dynamic Pricing Launch a Step Toward Becoming a Hotel-Like Franchisor?
items.summary: In addition to dynamic pricing, Airbnb has floated the idea of adding more products and services for hosts, ranging from design services to financing. The soft franchise model might be more appropriate for individual hosts who don't require multi-platform distribution.
